[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Recipe 1: Lentil Bolognese**  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Ingredients: 1 cup green lentils, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes, 1 teaspoon dried basil, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika (optional), salt and pepper, 1/4 cup red wine (optional), fresh parsley (for garnish).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Instructions for Lentil Bolognese:  
1. Heat olive oil, add onion, garlic, mushrooms, carrot, and celery. Cook until tender.  
2. Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, basil, oregano, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.  
3. Add red wine (if using) and simmer for 30-40 minutes.  
4. Serve over spaghetti, garnished with parsley.
